section.div: A machine learning project for classifying Iris flower species using petal and sepal measurements. Includes data preprocessing, model training, evaluation, and feature analysis using Python and scikit-learn.
“Predict house prices using Linear Regression on the Boston Housing dataset. Includes missing value handling, model evaluation, and visualization of predicted vs actual prices.

Predict Titanic survival using Logistic Regression. Cleaned data, encoded features, trained model, and visualized feature importance. Includes survival probabilities, plots, and ready-to-submit CSV for Kaggle.
Decision Tree to classify Iris flowers with dataset, visualization, and evaluation.
